data.title: 天雨亚子 · 霓虹夜雨中的严苛巡查
data.description: 歌赫娜商业街细雨纷飞的雨夜，街道两侧的红蓝霓虹灯倒映在积水街道上。亚子黑色风衣披在肩头，双手插袋快步行进，灰色双马尾发丝沾着点点晶莹雨雾。她目光锐利如刀，展现出作为歌赫娜治安二把手的冷艳威严。
data.action: walking with coat draped over shoulders, stern alert gaze, rain drizzle
data.lighting: vibrant crimson and blue neon reflections on wet asphalt
data.mood: sharp tactical vigilance and noir atmosphere
data.promptProse: Striding through a neon-bathed Gehenna avenue in the pouring rain, Amau Ako looks sharply ahead with her black jacket slung over her shoulders and horns gleaming beneath the drizzle.
data.animaCaption: Ako patrolling the neon-lit rainy street in Gehenna.
